queries.xnt_legacy:
SELECT m.warehouse_id, m.product_id, m.stock_status,
       w.code AS warehouse_code, p.code AS product_code, p.name AS product_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.occurred_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' OR (m.occurred_at BETWEEN '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-08-31 23:59:59' AND m.movement_type = 'OPENING') THEN m.qty_delta ELSE 0 END) AS opening,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.occurred_at BETWEEN '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-08-31 23:59:59' AND m.movement_type = 'RECEIPT' THEN m.qty_delta ELSE 0 END) AS receipt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.occurred_at BETWEEN '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-08-31 23:59:59' AND m.movement_type = 'ISSUE' THEN -m.qty_delta ELSE 0 END) AS issue,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.occurred_at BETWEEN '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-08-31 23:59:59' AND m.movement_type = 'COMPONENT_ISSUE' THEN -m.qty_delta ELSE 0 END) AS component_issue,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.occurred_at BETWEEN '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-08-31 23:59:59' AND m.movement_type = 'REVERSAL' THEN m.qty_delta ELSE 0 END) AS reversal_net
FROM stock_movements m
LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = m.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = m.product_id
WHERE m.occurred_at <= '2026-08-31 23:59:59'
GROUP BY m.warehouse_id, m.product_id, m.stock_status, w.code, p.code, p.name

       SUM(CASE WHEN m.occurred_at < '2026-08-01 00:00:00' OR (m.occurred_at BETWEEN '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-08-31 23:59:59' AND m.movement_type = 'OPENING') THEN m.qty_delta ELSE 0 END) AS opening,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.occurred_at BETWEEN '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-08-31 23:59:59' AND m.movement_type = 'RECEIPT' THEN m.qty_delta ELSE 0 END) AS receipt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.occurred_at BETWEEN '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-08-31 23:59:59' AND m.movement_type = 'ISSUE' THEN -m.qty_delta ELSE 0 END) AS issue,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.occurred_at BETWEEN '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-08-31 23:59:59' AND m.movement_type = 'COMPONENT_ISSUE' THEN -m.qty_delta ELSE 0 END) AS component_issue,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.occurred_at BETWEEN '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-08-31 23:59:59' AND m.movement_type = 'REVERSAL' THEN m.qty_delta ELSE 0 END) AS reversal_net
    FROM stock_movements m
